payload.reason: The evidence describes a system called ParityBOT that detects and classifies hateful tweets aimed at women in politics using a Twitter listener and analysis model.

claims.text: ParityBOT detects hateful tweets aimed at women by using a Twitter listener that collects and classifies tweets directed at a known list of women candidates.
The classification system of ParityBOT was validated on public online harassment datasets, indicating its effectiveness in identifying hateful tweets.
ParityBOT analyzes tweets in real-time using an asynchronous tweet analysis function for each tweet mentioning candidate usernames.
